verses.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
verses.fr: Paul, apôtre de Jésus Christ par la volonté de Dieu, et le frère Timothée,
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ የሆነ ጳውሎስ ጢሞቴዎስም ወንድሙ፥

verses.en: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: aux saints et fidèles frères en Christ qui sont à Colosses; que la grâce et la paix vous soient données de la part de Dieu notre Père!
verses.am: በቈላስይስ ለሚኖሩ ቅዱሳንና በክርስቶስ ለታመኑ ወንድሞች፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ሰላም ይሁን።

verses.en: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
verses.fr: Nous rendons grâces à Dieu, le Père de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ, et nous ne cessons de prier pour vous,

verses.en: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
verses.fr: ayant été informés de votre foi en Jésus-Christ et de votre charité pour tous les saints,
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ ስንጸልይ፥ በሰማይ ከተዘጋጀላችሁ ተስፋ የተነሣ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ስለ እምነታችሁ ለቅዱሳንም ሁሉ ስላላችሁ ፍቅር ሰምተን፥ የጌታችንን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን አባት እግዚአብሔርን ሁልጊዜ እናመሰግናለን፤ ስለዚህም ተስፋ በወንጌል እውነት ቃል አስቀድማችሁ ሰማችሁ።

verses.en: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
verses.fr: cause de l''espérance qui vous est réservée dans les cieux, et que la parole de la vérité, la parole de l''Evangile vous a précédemment fait connaître.
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ ስንጸልይ፥ በሰማይ ከተዘጋጀላችሁ ተስፋ የተነሣ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ስለ እምነታችሁ ለቅዱሳንም ሁሉ ስላላችሁ ፍቅር ሰምተን፥ የጌታችንን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን አባት እግዚአብሔርን ሁልጊዜ እናመሰግናለን፤ ስለዚህም ተስፋ በወንጌል እውነት ቃል አስቀድማችሁ ሰማችሁ።

verses.en: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
verses.fr: Il est au milieu de vous, et dans le monde entier; il porte des fruits, et il va grandissant, comme c''est aussi le cas parmi vous, depuis le jour où vous avez entendu et connu la grâce de Dieu conformément à la vérité,
verses.am: ይህም በዓለም ሁሉ ደግሞ እንዳለ ወደ እናንተ ደርሶአል፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ጸጋ በእውነት ከሰማችሁበትና ካወቃችሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ፥ በእናንተ ደግሞ እንዳለ እንዲህ በዓለም ፍሬ ያፈራል ያድግማል።

verses.en: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
verses.fr: d''après les instructions que vous avez reçues d''Epaphras, notre bien-aimé compagnon de service, qui est pour vous un fidèle ministre de Christ,
verses.am: ከተወደደ ከእኛም ጋር አብሮ ባሪያ ከሆነው ከኤጳፍራ እንዲህ ተማራችሁ፥ እርሱም ስለ እናንተ ታማኝ የክርስቶስ አገልጋይ ነው።

verses.en: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
verses.fr: et qui nous a appris de quelle charité l''Esprit vous anime.
verses.am: ደግሞም በመንፈስ ስለሚሆን ስለ ፍቅራችሁ አስታወቀን።

verses.en: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
verses.fr: C''est pour cela que nous aussi, depuis le jour où nous en avons été informés, nous ne cessons de prier Dieu pour vous, et de demander que vous soyez remplis de la connaissance de sa volonté, en toute sagesse et intelligence spirituelle,
verses.am: ስለዚሁ እኛ ደግሞ ይህን ከሰማንበት ቀን ጀምረን የፈቃዱ እውቀት መንፈሳዊ ጥበብንና አእምሮን ሁሉ እንዲሞላባችሁ እየለመንን፥ ስለ እናንተ ጸሎትን አልተውንም።

verses.en: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
verses.fr: pour marcher d''une manière digne du Seigneur et lui être entièrement agréables, portant des fruits en toutes sortes de bonnes oeuvres et croissant par la connaissance de Dieu,
verses.am: ከደስታም ጋር በሁሉ ለመጽናትና ለመታገሥ እንደ ክብሩ ጉልበት መጠን በኃይል ሁሉ እየበረታችሁ፥ በቅዱሳንም ርስት በብርሃን እንድንካፈል ያበቃንን አብን እያመሰገናችሁ፥ በነገር ሁሉ ደስ ልታሰኙ ለጌታ እንደሚገባ ትመላለሱ ዘንድ እንለምናለን።

verses.en: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
verses.fr: fortifiés à tous égards par sa puissance glorieuse, en sorte que vous soyez toujours et avec joie persévérants et patients.
verses.am: ከደስታም ጋር በሁሉ ለመጽናትና ለመታገሥ እንደ ክብሩ ጉልበት መጠን በኃይል ሁሉ እየበረታችሁ፥ በቅዱሳንም ርስት በብርሃን እንድንካፈል ያበቃንን አብን እያመሰገናችሁ፥ በነገር ሁሉ ደስ ልታሰኙ ለጌታ እንደሚገባ ትመላለሱ ዘንድ እንለምናለን።

verses.en: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
verses.fr: Rendez grâces au Père, qui vous a rendus capables d''avoir part à l''héritage des saints dans la lumière,
verses.am: እርሱም ከሁሉ በፊት ነው ሁሉም በእርሱ ተጋጥሞአል።

verses.en: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
verses.fr: qui nous a délivrés de la puissance des ténèbres et nous a transportés dans le royaume du Fils de son amour,
verses.am: እርሱም ከሁሉ በፊት ነው ሁሉም በእርሱ ተጋጥሞአል።

verses.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
verses.fr: en qui nous avons la rédemption, la rémission des péchés.
verses.am: እርሱም ከሁሉ በፊት ነው ሁሉም በእርሱ ተጋጥሞአል።

verses.en: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
verses.fr: Il est l''image du Dieu invisible, le premier-né de toute la création.
verses.am: እርሱም የአካሉ ማለት የቤተ ክርስቲያን ራስ ነው። እርሱም በሁሉ ፊተኛ ይሆን ዘንድ፥ መጀመሪያ ከሙታንም በኵር ነው።

verses.en: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
verses.fr: Car en lui ont été créées toutes les choses qui sont dans les cieux et sur la terre, les visibles et les invisibles, trônes, dignités, dominations, autorités. Tout a été créé par lui et pour lui.
verses.am: ይህም፥ ተመሥርታችሁና ተደላድላችሁ ከሰማችሁትም ከወንጌል ተስፋ ሳትናወጡ፥ በሃይማኖት ጸንታችሁ ብትኖሩ ይሆናል። ያም ወንጌል ከሰማይ በታች ባለው ፍጥረት ሁሉ ዘንድ የተሰበከ ነው፥ እኔም ጳውሎስ የእርሱ አገልጋይ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
verses.fr: Il est avant toutes choses, et toutes choses subsistent en lui.
verses.am: ይህም፥ ተመሥርታችሁና ተደላድላችሁ ከሰማችሁትም ከወንጌል ተስፋ ሳትናወጡ፥ በሃይማኖት ጸንታችሁ ብትኖሩ ይሆናል። ያም ወንጌል ከሰማይ በታች ባለው ፍጥረት ሁሉ ዘንድ የተሰበከ ነው፥ እኔም ጳውሎስ የእርሱ አገልጋይ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
verses.fr: Il est la tête du corps de l''Eglise; il est le commencement, le premier-né d''entre les morts, afin d''être en tout le premier.
verses.am: ይህም፥ ተመሥርታችሁና ተደላድላችሁ ከሰማችሁትም ከወንጌል ተስፋ ሳትናወጡ፥ በሃይማኖት ጸንታችሁ ብትኖሩ ይሆናል። ያም ወንጌል ከሰማይ በታች ባለው ፍጥረት ሁሉ ዘንድ የተሰበከ ነው፥ እኔም ጳውሎስ የእርሱ አገልጋይ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
verses.fr: Car Dieu a voulu que toute plénitude habitât en lui;
verses.am: አሁን በመከራዬ ስለ እናንተ ደስ ይለኛል፥ ስለ አካሉም ማለት ስለ ቤተ ክርስቲያን በሥጋዬ በክርስቶስ መከራ የጐደለውን እፈጽማለሁ።

verses.en: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
verses.fr: il a voulu par lui réconcilier tout avec lui-même, tant ce qui est sur la terre que ce qui est dans les cieux, en faisant la paix par lui, par le sang de sa croix.
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ እንደ ተሰጠኝ እንደ እግዚአብሔር መጋቢነት፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ፈጽሜ እንድሰብክ እኔ የቤተ ክርስቲያን አገልጋይ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
verses.fr: Et vous, qui étiez autrefois étrangers et ennemis par vos pensées et par vos mauvaises oeuvres, il vous a maintenant réconciliés
verses.am: ይህም ቃል ከዘላለምና ከትውልዶች ጀምሮ ተሰውሮ የነበረ ምሥጢር ነው፥ አሁን ግን ለቅዱሳኑ ተገልጦአል።

verses.en: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
verses.fr: par sa mort dans le corps de sa chair, pour vous faire paraître devant lui saints, irrépréhensibles et sans reproche,
verses.am: ለእነርሱም እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ዘንድ ያለው የዚህ ምሥጢር ክብር ባለ ጠግነት ምን እንደ ሆነ ሊያስታውቅ ወደደ፥ ምሥጢሩም የክብር ተስፋ ያለው ክርስቶስ በእናንተ ዘንድ መሆኑ ነው።

verses.en: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
verses.fr: si du moins vous demeurez fondés et inébranlables dans la foi, sans vous détourner de l''espérance de l''Evangile que vous avez entendu, qui a été prêché à toute créature sous le ciel, et dont moi Paul, j''ai été fait ministre.
verses.am: እኛም በክርስቶስ ፍጹም የሚሆን ሰውን ሁሉ እናቀርብ ዘንድ ሰውን ሁሉ እየገሠጽን ሰውንም ሁሉ በጥበብ ሁሉ እያስተማርን የምንሰብከው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:
verses.fr: Je me réjouis maintenant dans mes souffrances pour vous; et ce qui manque aux souffrances de Christ, je l''achève en ma chair, pour son corps, qui est l''Eglise.
verses.am: ለዚህም ነገር ደግሞ፥ በእኔ በኃይል እንደሚሠራ እንደ አሠራሩ እየተጋደልሁ፥ እደክማለሁ።

verses.en: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;
verses.fr: C''est d''elle que j''ai été fait ministre, selon la charge que Dieu m''a donnée auprès de vous, afin que j''annonçasse pleinement la parole de Dieu,
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ እንደ ተሰጠኝ እንደ እግዚአብሔር መጋቢነት፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ፈጽሜ እንድሰብክ እኔ የቤተ ክርስቲያን አገልጋይ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
verses.fr: le mystère caché de tout temps et dans tous les âges, mais révélé maintenant à ses saints,
verses.am: ይህም ቃል ከዘላለምና ከትውልዶች ጀምሮ ተሰውሮ የነበረ ምሥጢር ነው፥ አሁን ግን ለቅዱሳኑ ተገልጦአል።

verses.en: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
verses.fr: qui Dieu a voulu faire connaître quelle est la glorieuse richesse de ce mystère parmi les païens, savoir: Christ en vous, l''espérance de la gloire.
verses.am: ለእነርሱም እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ዘንድ ያለው የዚህ ምሥጢር ክብር ባለ ጠግነት ምን እንደ ሆነ ሊያስታውቅ ወደደ፥ ምሥጢሩም የክብር ተስፋ ያለው ክርስቶስ በእናንተ ዘንድ መሆኑ ነው።

verses.en: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
verses.fr: C''est lui que nous annonçons, exhortant tout homme, et instruisant tout homme en toute sagesse, afin de présenter à Dieu tout homme, devenu parfait en Christ.
verses.am: እኛም በክርስቶስ ፍጹም የሚሆን ሰውን ሁሉ እናቀርብ ዘንድ ሰውን ሁሉ እየገሠጽን ሰውንም ሁሉ በጥበብ ሁሉ እያስተማርን የምንሰብከው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
verses.fr: C''est à quoi je travaille, en combattant avec sa force, qui agit puissamment en moi.
verses.am: ለዚህም ነገር ደግሞ፥ በእኔ በኃይል እንደሚሠራ እንደ አሠራሩ እየተጋደልሁ፥ እደክማለሁ።

verses.en: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
verses.fr: Je veux, en effet, que vous sachiez combien est grand le combat que je soutiens pour vous, et pour ceux qui sont à Laodicée, et pour tous ceux qui n''ont pas vu mon visage en la chair,
verses.am: ስለ እናንተና በሎዶቅያ ስላሉት ፊቴንም በሥጋ ስላላዩት ሁሉ እንዴት ያለ ትልቅ መጋደል እንዳለኝ ልታውቁ እወዳለሁና።

verses.en: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
verses.fr: afin qu''ils aient le coeur rempli de consolation, qu''ils soient unis dans la charité, et enrichis d''une pleine intelligence pour connaître le mystère de Dieu, savoir Christ,
verses.am: ልባቸው እንዲጸናና፥ በፍቅርም ተባብረው በማስተዋል ወደሚገኝበት ወደ መረዳት ባለ ጠግነት ሁሉ እንዲደርሱ የእግዚአብሔርንም ምሥጢር እርሱንም ክርስቶስን እንዲያውቁ እጋደላለሁ።

verses.en: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.fr: mystère dans lequel sont cachés tous les trésors de la sagesse et de la science.
verses.am: የተሰወረ የጥበብና የእውቀት መዝገብ ሁሉ በእርሱ ነውና።

verses.en: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
verses.fr: Je dis cela afin que personne ne vous trompe par des discours séduisants.
verses.am: ማንም በሚያባብል ቃል እንዳያስታችሁ ይህን እላለሁ።

verses.en: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
verses.fr: Car, si je suis absent de corps, je suis avec vous en esprit, voyant avec joie le bon ordre qui règne parmi vous, et la fermeté de votre foi en Christ.
verses.am: በሥጋ ምንም እንኳ ብርቅ፥ በመንፈስ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝና፥ ሥርዓታችሁንም በክርስቶስም ያለውን የእምነታችሁን ጽናት እያየሁ ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.en: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, comme vous avez reçu le Seigneur Jésus-Christ, marchez en lui,
verses.am: እንግዲህ ጌታን ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን እንደ ተቀበላችሁት በእርሱ ተመላለሱ።

verses.en: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
verses.fr: tant enracinés et fondés en lui, et affermis par la foi, d''après les instructions qui vous ont été données, et abondez en actions de grâces.
verses.am: ሥር ሰዳችሁ በእርሱ ታነጹ፥ እንደ ተማራችሁም በሃይማኖት ጽኑ፥ ምስጋናም ይብዛላችሁ።

verses.en: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
verses.fr: Prenez garde que personne ne fasse de vous sa proie par la philosophie et par une vaine tromperie, s''appuyant sur la tradition des hommes, sur les rudiments du monde, et non sur Christ.
verses.am: እንደ ክርስቶስ ትምህርት ሳይሆን፥ እንደ ሰው ወግና እንደ ዓለማዊ እንደ መጀመሪያ ትምህርት ባለ በፍልስፍና በከንቱም መታለል ማንም እንዳይማርካችሁ ተጠበቁ።

verses.en: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
verses.fr: Car en lui habite corporellement toute la plénitude de la divinité.
verses.am: በእርሱ የመለኮት ሙላት ሁሉ በሰውነት ተገልጦ ይኖራልና።

verses.en: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
verses.fr: Vous avez tout pleinement en lui, qui est le chef de toute domination et de toute autorité.
verses.am: ለአለቅነትና ለሥልጣንም ሁሉ ራስ በሆነ በእርሱ ሆናችሁ ተሞልታችኋል።

verses.en: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
verses.fr: Et c''est en lui que vous avez été circoncis d''une circoncision que la main n''a pas faite, mais de la circoncision de Christ, qui consiste dans le dépouillement du corps de la chair:
verses.am: የሥጋንም ሰውነት በመገፈፍ፥ በክርስቶስ መገረዝ፥ በእጅ ባልተደረገ መገረዝ በእርሱ ሆናችሁ ደግሞ ተገረዛችሁ።

verses.en: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
verses.fr: ayant été ensevelis avec lui par le baptême, vous êtes aussi ressuscités en lui et avec lui, par la foi en la puissance de Dieu, qui l''a ressuscité des morts.
verses.am: በጥምቀትም ከእርሱ ጋር ተቀብራችሁ፥ በጥምቀት ደግሞ፥ ከሙታን ባስነሣው በእግዚአብሔር አሠራር በማመናችሁ፥ ከእርሱ ጋር ተነሣችሁ።

verses.en: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
verses.fr: Vous qui étiez morts par vos offenses et par l''incirconcision de votre chair, il vous a rendus à la vie avec lui, en nous faisant grâce pour toutes nos offenses;
verses.am: እናንተም በበደላችሁና ሥጋችሁን ባለመገረዝ ሙታን በሆናችሁ ጊዜ፥ ከእርሱ ጋር ሕይወትን ሰጣችሁ። በደላችሁን ሁሉ ይቅር አላችሁ።

verses.en: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
verses.fr: il a effacé l''acte dont les ordonnances nous condamnaient et qui subsistait contre nous, et il l''a détruit en le clouant à la croix;
verses.am: በእኛ ላይ የነበረውን የሚቃወመንንም በትእዛዛት የተጻፈውን የዕዳ ጽሕፈት ደመሰሰው። እርሱንም በመስቀል ጠርቆ ከመንገድ አስወግዶታል።

verses.en: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
verses.fr: il a dépouillé les dominations et les autorités, et les a livrées publiquement en spectacle, en triomphant d''elles par la croix.
verses.am: አለቅነትንና ሥልጣናትን ገፎ፥ ድል በመንሣት በእርሱ እያዞራቸው በግልጥ አሳያቸው።

verses.en: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
verses.fr: Que personne donc ne vous juge au sujet du manger ou du boire, ou au sujet d''une fête, d''une nouvelle lune, ou des sabbats:
verses.am: እንግዲህ በመብል ወይም በመጠጥ ወይም ስለ በዓል ወይም ስለ ወር መባቻ ወይም ስለ ሰንበት ማንም አይፍረድባችሁ።

verses.en: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
verses.fr: c''était l''ombre des choses à venir, mais le corps est en Christ.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሊመጡ ያሉት ነገሮች ጥላ ናቸውና፥ አካሉ ግን የክርስቶስ ነው።

verses.en: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
verses.fr: Qu''aucun homme, sous une apparence d''humilité et par un culte des anges, ne vous ravisse à son gré le prix de la course, tandis qu''il s''abandonne à ses visions et qu''il est enflé d''un vain orgueil par ses pensées charnelles,
verses.am: ትሕትናንና የመላእክትን አምልኮ እየወደደ፥ ባላየውም ያለ ፈቃድ እየገባ፥ በሥጋዊም አእምሮ በከንቱ እየታበየ ማንም አይፍረድባችሁ።

verses.en: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
verses.fr: sans s''attacher au chef, dont tout le corps, assisté et solidement assemblé par des jointures et des liens, tire l''accroissement que Dieu donne.
verses.am: እንደዚህ ያለ ሰው ራስ ወደሚሆነው አይጠጋም፥ ከእርሱም አካል ሁሉ በጅማትና በማሰሪያ ምግብን እየተቀበለ እየተጋጠመም፥ እግዚአብሔር በሚሰጠው ማደግ ያድጋል።

verses.en: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
verses.fr: Si vous êtes morts avec Christ aux rudiments du monde, pourquoi, comme si vous viviez dans le monde, vous impose-t-on ces préceptes:
verses.am: እንደ ሰው ሥርዓትና ትምህርት። አትያዝ፥ አትቅመስ፥ አትንካ ለሚሉት ትእዛዛት በዓለም እንደምትኖሩ ስለ ምን ትገዛላችሁ? እነዚህ ሁሉ በመደረግ ሊጠፉ ተወስነዋልና።

verses.en: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
verses.fr: Ne prends pas! ne goûte pas! ne touche pas!
verses.am: እንደ ሰው ሥርዓትና ትምህርት። አትያዝ፥ አትቅመስ፥ አትንካ ለሚሉት ትእዛዛት በዓለም እንደምትኖሩ ስለ ምን ትገዛላችሁ? እነዚህ ሁሉ በመደረግ ሊጠፉ ተወስነዋልና።

verses.en: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
verses.fr: préceptes qui tous deviennent pernicieux par l''abus, et qui ne sont fondés que sur les ordonnances et les doctrines des hommes?
verses.am: ይህ እንደ ገዛ ፈቃድህ በማምለክና በትሕትና ሥጋንም በመጨቆን ጥበብ ያለው ይመስላል፥ ነገር ግን ሥጋ ያለ ልክ እንዳይጠግብ ለመከልከል ምንም አይጠቅምም።

verses.en: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body: not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
verses.fr: Ils ont, à la vérité, une apparence de sagesse, en ce qu''ils indiquent un culte volontaire, de l''humilité, et le mépris du corps, mais ils sont sans aucun mérite et contribuent à la satisfaction de la chair.
verses.am: ይህ እንደ ገዛ ፈቃድህ በማምለክና በትሕትና ሥጋንም በመጨቆን ጥበብ ያለው ይመስላል፥ ነገር ግን ሥጋ ያለ ልክ እንዳይጠግብ ለመከልከል ምንም አይጠቅምም።

verses.en: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
verses.fr: Si donc vous êtes ressuscités avec Christ, cherchez les choses d''en haut, où Christ est assis à la droite de Dieu.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከክርስቶስ ጋር ከተነሣችሁ፥ ክርስቶስ በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ተቀምጦ ባለበት በላይ ያለውን እሹ።

verses.en: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
verses.fr: Affectionnez-vous aux choses d''en haut, et non à celles qui sont sur la terre.
verses.am: በላይ ያለውን አስቡ እንጂ በምድር ያለውን አይደለም።

verses.en: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
verses.fr: Car vous êtes morts, et votre vie est cachée avec Christ en Dieu.
verses.am: ሞታችኋልና፥ ሕይወታችሁም በእግዚአብሔር ከክርስቶስ ጋር ተሰውሮአልና።

verses.en: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
verses.fr: Quand Christ, votre vie, paraîtra, alors vous paraîtrez aussi avec lui dans la gloire.
verses.am: ሕይወታችሁ የሆነ ክርስቶስ በሚገለጥበት ጊዜ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ እናንተ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር በክብር ትገለጣላችሁ።

verses.en: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
verses.fr: Faites donc mourir les membres qui sont sur la terre, l''impudicité, l''impureté, les passions, les mauvais désirs, et la cupidité, qui est une idolâtrie.
verses.am: እንግዲህ በምድር ያሉቱን ብልቶቻችሁን ግደሉ፥ እነዚህም ዝሙትና ርኵሰት ፍትወትም ክፉ ምኞትም ጣኦትንም ማምለክ የሆነ መጎምጀት ነው።

verses.en: For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
verses.fr: C''est à cause de ces choses que la colère de Dieu vient sur les fils de la rébellion,
verses.am: በእነዚህም ጠንቅ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በማይታዘዙ ልጆች ላይ ይመጣል።

verses.en: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
verses.fr: parmi lesquels vous marchiez autrefois, lorsque vous viviez dans ces péchés.
verses.am: እናንተም ደግሞ ትኖሩባቸው በነበራችሁ ጊዜ፥ በፊት በእነዚህ ተመላለሳችሁ።

verses.en: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
verses.fr: Mais maintenant, renoncez à toutes ces choses, à la colère, à l''animosité, à la méchanceté, à la calomnie, aux paroles déshonnêtes qui pourraient sortir de votre bouche.
verses.am: አሁን ግን እናንተ ደግሞ ቍጣንና ንዴትን ክፋትንም፥ ከአፋችሁም ስድብን የሚያሳፍርንም ንግግር እነዚህን ሁሉ አስወግዱ።

verses.en: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
verses.fr: Ne mentez pas les uns aux autres, vous étant dépouillés du vieil homme et de ses oeuvres,
verses.am: እርስ በርሳችሁ ውሸት አትነጋገሩ፥ አሮጌውን ሰው ከሥራው ጋር ገፋችሁታልና፥

verses.en: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
verses.fr: et ayant revêtu l''homme nouveau, qui se renouvelle, dans la connaissance, selon l''image de celui qui l''a créé.
verses.am: የፈጠረውንም ምሳሌ እንዲመስል እውቀትን ለማግኘት የሚታደሰውን አዲሱን ሰው ለብሳችሁታል።

verses.en: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
verses.fr: Il n''y a ici ni Grec ni Juif, ni circoncis ni incirconcis, ni barbare ni Scythe, ni esclave ni libre; mais Christ est tout et en tous.
verses.am: በዚያም የግሪክ ሰው አይሁዳዊም የተገረዘም ያልተገረዘም አረማዊም እስኩቴስም ባሪያም ጨዋ ሰውም መሆን አልተቻለም፥ ነገር ግን ክርስቶስ ሁሉ ነው፥ በሁሉም ነው።

verses.en: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
verses.fr: Ainsi donc, comme des élus de Dieu, saints et bien-aimés, revêtez-vous d''entrailles de miséricorde, de bonté, d''humilité, de douceur, de patience.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ምርጦች ቅዱሳን ሆናችሁ የተወደዳችሁም ሆናችሁ፥ ምሕረትን፥ ርኅራኄን፥ ቸርነትን፥ ትህትናን፥ የዋህነትን፥ ትዕግሥትን ልበሱ።

verses.en: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
verses.fr: Supportez-vous les uns les autres, et, si l''un a sujet de se plaindre de l''autre, pardonnez-vous réciproquement. De même que Christ vous a pardonné, pardonnez-vous aussi.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳችሁ ትዕግሥትን አድርጉ፥ ማንም በባልንጀራው ላይ የሚነቅፈው ነገር ካለው፥ ይቅር ተባባሉ። ክርስቶስ ይቅር እንዳላችሁ እናንተ ደግሞ እንዲሁ አድርጉ።

verses.en: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
verses.fr: Mais par-dessus toutes ces choses revêtez-vous de la charité, qui est le lien de la perfection.
verses.am: በእነዚህም ሁሉ ላይ የፍጻሜ ማሰሪያ የሆነውን ፍቅርን ልበሱት።

verses.en: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
verses.fr: Et que la paix de Christ, à laquelle vous avez été appelés pour former un seul corps, règne dans vos coeurs. Et soyez reconnaissants.
verses.am: በአንድ አካልም የተጠራችሁለት ደግሞ የክርስቶስ ሰላም በልባችሁ ይግዛ። የምታመሰግኑም ሁኑ።

verses.en: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
verses.fr: Que la parole de Christ habite parmi vous abondamment; instruisez-vous et exhortez-vous les uns les autres en toute sagesse, par des psaumes, par des hymnes, par des cantiques spirituels, chantant à Dieu dans vos coeurs sous l''inspiration de la grâce.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በሙላት ይኑርባችሁ። በጥበብ ሁሉ እርስ በርሳችሁ አስተምሩና ገሥጹ። በመዝሙርና በዝማሬ በመንፈሳዊም ቅኔ በጸጋው በልባችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ።

verses.en: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
verses.fr: Et quoi que vous fassiez, en parole ou en oeuvre, faites tout au nom du Seigneur Jésus, en rendant par lui des actions de grâces à Dieu le Père.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አብን በእርሱ እያመሰገናችሁ፥ በቃል ቢሆን ወይም በሥራ የምታደርጉትን ሁሉ በጌታ በኢየሱስ ስም አድርጉት።

verses.en: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
verses.fr: Femmes, soyez soumises à vos maris, comme il convient dans le Seigneur.
verses.am: ሚስቶች ሆይ፥ በጌታ እንደሚገባ ለባሎቻችሁ ተገዙ።

verses.en: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
verses.fr: Maris, aimez vos femmes, et ne vous aigrissez pas contre elles.
verses.am: ባሎች ሆይ፥ ሚስቶቻችሁን ውደዱ መራራም አትሁኑባቸው።

verses.en: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Enfants, obéissez en toutes choses à vos parents, car cela est agréable dans le Seigneur.
verses.am: ልጆች ሆይ፥ ይህ ለጌታ ደስ የሚያሰኝ ነውና በሁሉ ለወላጆቻችሁ ታዘዙ።

verses.en: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
verses.fr: Pères, n''irritez pas vos enfants, de peur qu''ils ne se découragent.
verses.am: አባቶች ሆይ፥ ልባቸው እንዳይዝል ልጆቻችሁን አታበሳጩአቸው።

verses.en: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God;
verses.fr: Serviteurs, obéissez en toutes choses à vos maîtres selon la chair, non pas seulement sous leurs yeux, comme pour plaire aux hommes, mais avec simplicité de coeur, dans la crainte du Seigneur.
verses.am: ባሪያዎች ሆይ፥ በቅን ልብ ጌታን እየፈራችሁ እንጂ፥ ለሰው ደስ እንደምታሰኙ ለታይታ የምትገዙ ሳትሆኑ፥ በሥጋ ጌቶቻችሁ ለሆኑ በሁሉ ታዘዙ።

verses.en: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
verses.fr: Tout ce que vous faites, faites-le de bon coeur, comme pour le Seigneur et non pour des hommes,
verses.am: ለሰው ሳይሆን ለጌታ እንደምታደርጉ፥ የምታደርጉትን ሁሉ በትጋት አድርጉት፥

verses.en: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
verses.fr: sachant que vous recevrez du Seigneur l''héritage pour récompense. Servez Christ, le Seigneur.
verses.am: ከጌታ የርስትን ብድራት እንድትቀበሉ ታውቃላችሁና። የምታገለግሉት ጌታ ክርስቶስ ነውና።

verses.en: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
verses.fr: Car celui qui agit injustement recevra selon son injustice, et il n''y a point d''acception de personnes.
verses.am: የሚበድልም የበደለውን በብድራት ይቀበላል፥ ለሰው ፊትም አድልዎ የለም።

verses.en: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
verses.fr: Maîtres, accordez à vos serviteurs ce qui est juste et équitable, sachant que vous aussi vous avez un maître dans le ciel.
verses.am: ጌቶች ሆይ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ በሰማይ ጌታ እንዳላችሁ ታውቃላችሁና ለባሪያዎቻችሁ በጽድቅና በቅንነት አድርጉላቸው።

verses.en: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
verses.fr: Persévérez dans la prière, veillez-y avec actions de grâces.
verses.am: ከማመስገን ጋር በጸሎት እየነቃችሁ ለእርሱ ትጉ።

verses.en: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
verses.fr: Priez en même temps pour nous, afin que Dieu nous ouvre une porte pour la parole, en sorte que je puisse annoncer le mystère de Christ, pour lequel je suis dans les chaînes,
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ስለ እርሱ ደግሞ የታሰርሁበትን የክርስቶስን ምሥጢር እንድንነግር እግዚአብሔር የቃሉን ደጅ ይከፍትልን ዘንድ ስለ እኛ ደግሞ ጸልዩ።

verses.en: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
verses.fr: et le faire connaître comme je dois en parler.
verses.am: ልናገር እንደሚገባኝ ያህል እገልጠው ዘንድ ጸልዩልኝ።

verses.en: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
verses.fr: Conduisez-vous avec sagesse envers ceux du dehors, et rachetez le temps.
verses.am: ዘመኑን እየዋጃችሁ፥ በውጭ ባሉቱ ዘንድ በጥበብ ተመላለሱ።

verses.en: Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
verses.fr: Que votre parole soit toujours accompagnée de grâce, assaisonnée de sel, afin que vous sachiez comment il faut répondre à chacun.
verses.am: ለእያንዳንዱ እንዴት እንድትመልሱ እንደሚገባችሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ ንግግራችሁ ሁልጊዜ፥ በጨው እንደ ተቀመመ፥ በጸጋ ይሁን።

verses.en: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
verses.fr: Tychique, le bien-aimé frère et le fidèle ministre, mon compagnon de service dans le Seigneur, vous communiquera tout ce qui me concerne.
verses.am: የተወደደ ወንድምና የታመነ አገልጋይ በጌታም አብሮኝ ባሪያ የሆነ ቲኪቆስ ኑሮዬን ሁሉ ያስታውቃችኋል።

verses.en: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
verses.fr: Je l''envoie exprès vers vous, pour que vous connaissiez notre situation, et pour qu''il console vos coeurs.

verses.en: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
verses.fr: Je l''envoie avec Onésime, le fidèle et bien-aimé frère, qui est des vôtres. Ils vous informeront de tout ce qui se passe ici.
verses.am: ወሬያችንን እንድታውቁና ልባችሁን እንዲያጽናና፥ ከእናንተ ከሆነውና ከታመነው ከተወደደውም ወንድም ከአናሲሞስ ጋር ወደ እናንተ የምልከው ስለዚህ ምክንያት ነው። የዚህን ስፍራ ወሬ ሁሉ ያስታውቁአችኋል።

verses.en: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
verses.fr: Aristarque, mon compagnon de captivité, vous salue, ainsi que Marc, le cousin de Barnabas, au sujet duquel vous avez reçu des ordres s''il va chez vous, accueillez-le;
verses.am: ከእናንተ የሆነ የክርስቶስ ባሪያ ኤጳፍራ ሰላምታ ያቀርብላችኋል። በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ሁሉ ተረድታችሁና ፍጹማን ሆናችሁ እንድትቆሙ፥ ሁልጊዜ ስለ እናንተ በጸሎቱ ይጋደላል።

verses.en: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
verses.fr: Jésus, appelé Justus, vous salue aussi. Ils sont du nombre des circoncis, et les seuls qui aient travaillé avec moi pour le royaume de Dieu, et qui aient été pour moi une consolation.
verses.am: ከእናንተ የሆነ የክርስቶስ ባሪያ ኤጳፍራ ሰላምታ ያቀርብላችኋል። በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ሁሉ ተረድታችሁና ፍጹማን ሆናችሁ እንድትቆሙ፥ ሁልጊዜ ስለ እናንተ በጸሎቱ ይጋደላል።

verses.en: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
verses.fr: Epaphras, qui est des vôtres, vous salue: serviteur de Jésus-Christ, il ne cesse de combattre pour vous dans ses prières, afin que, parfaits et pleinement persuadés, vous persistiez dans une entière soumission à la volonté de Dieu.
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ በሎዶቅያም በኢያራ ከተማም ስላሉቱ እጅግ እንዲቀና እመሰክርለታለሁና።

verses.en: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
verses.fr: Car je lui rends le témoignage qu''il a une grande sollicitude pour vous, pour ceux de Laodicée, et pour ceux d''Hiérapolis.
verses.am: የተወደደው ባለ መድኃኒቱ ሉቃስ ዴማስም ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.en: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
verses.fr: Luc, le médecin bien-aimé, vous salue, ainsi que Démas.
verses.am: በሎዶቅያ ላሉቱ ወንድሞችና ለንምፉን በቤቱም ላለች ቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰላምታ አቅርቡልን።

verses.en: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
verses.fr: Saluez les frères qui sont à Laodicée, et Nymphas, et l''Eglise qui est dans sa maison.
verses.am: ይህችም መልእክት በእናንተ ዘንድ ከተነበበች በኋላ፥ በሎዶቅያ ሰዎች ማኅበር ደግሞ እንድትነበብ አድርጉ። ከሎዶቅያም የምትገኘውን መልእክት እናንተ ደግሞ አንብቡ።

verses.en: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
verses.fr: Lorsque cette lettre aura été lue chez vous, faites en sorte qu''elle soit aussi lue dans l''Eglise des Laodicéens, et que vous lisiez à votre tour celle qui vous arrivera de Laodicée.
verses.am: ለአክሪጳም። በጌታ የተቀበልኸውን አገልግሎት እንድትፈጽሙው ተጠንቀቅ በሉልኝ።

verses.en: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
verses.fr: Et dites à Archippe: Prends garde au ministère que tu as reçu dans le Seigneur, afin de le bien remplir.
verses.am: በገዛ እጄ የተጻፈ የእኔ የጳውሎስ ሰላምታ ይህ ነው። እስራቴን አስቡ። ጸጋ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.en: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.fr: Je vous salue, moi Paul, de ma propre main. Souvenez-vous de mes liens. Que la grâce soit avec vous!
verses.am: በገዛ እጄ የተጻፈ የእኔ የጳውሎስ ሰላምታ ይህ ነው። እስራቴን አስቡ። ጸጋ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን።
